active_guardrails: Completeness Rule: Explicitly unpack all 3 steps: R (Retrieve), A (Augment), G (Generate) in distinct bullet points.
Interactive Closure Rule: Conclude with an active 'Check Your Understanding' mini-quiz with 2-3 questions and friendly answer rationales.
Always feature a relatable Indian student analogy (e.g. Open-Book vs Closed-Book exam) in the first 2 sections.
Simplification Rule: Ensure sentence length remains under 16 words and avoid passive academic terminology.
Jargon Ban Rule: Ensure terms like High reading complexity (Grade 10.37), Abstract conceptual description without concrete student anchor are accompanied by 'in simple words' definitions.
Always define 'Vector' or 'Embedding' immediately as 'a numerical address/tag that stores meaning, just like a pin on Google Maps'.

Jargon Ban Rule: Ensure terms like High reading complexity (Grade 17.59), orthogonal paradigms shift in probabilistic autoregressive transformer architectures are accompanied by 'in simple words' definitions.
Strict Fact-Check Rule: State explicitly that RAG does not retrain weights, but provides real-time reference notes to the AI prompt.
Never use the term 'Retrieval' without immediately giving the synonym 'Searching/Fetching the right page from a book'.
Pedagogical Anchor Rule: Include both the Open-Book Exam analogy AND a concrete step-by-step query walkthrough.
Explicitly emphasize that RAG does NOT update AI model weights or retrain the neural network; it gives fresh context in the prompt note.

Jargon Ban Rule: Ensure terms like The internal neural network weights of the LLM are modified directly, RAG is primarily a machine learning model training algorithm are accompanied by 'in simple words' definitions.

Jargon Ban Rule: Ensure terms like Critical factual hallucination: 'retraining the artificial neural network', Critical factual hallucination: 'gradient descent ensures that the model's weights' are accompanied by 'in simple words' definitions.
Keep every sentence short and punchy: break sentences with more than one 'and/which/because' into two separate sentences.

Jargon Ban Rule: Ensure terms like orthogonal paradigms shift in probabilistic autoregressive transformer architectures, epistemic uncertainty precipitates stochastic hallucinations are accompanied by 'in simple words' definitions.
